# Book_16 — The Ground Beneath the Path
:::


::: {.callout-note}
The coda — after fifteen books of model and consumption surfaces, the governance substrate must finally stand on real ground: a single hardened Windows Server 2025 host running Gitea behind IIS, inside the boundary, where canon physically lives and the rules the series argued for become executable at the moment of the commit. This book is the narrative bridge to the canonical build runbook; it tells the *why*, and points to where the *how* is written.
:::
